title: Read every direction from the SVD
brief: Get components, scores, and explained variances from the SVD of centred data, find the same directions with an eigendecomposition of the covariance, and compute the variance shares.
hints: np.linalg.svd returns V transposed. The components are Vt[:k].T, and the scores are Xc @ components.
explained_variance is s[:k] ** 2 / (n - 1), where s holds the singular values of the centred data.
np.linalg.eigh returns eigenvalues smallest first. Reverse both the eigenvalues and the columns of the eigenvectors, then keep k.
explained_variance_ratio: s = np.linalg.svd(Xc, compute_uv=False), then s ** 2 / np.sum(s ** 2). Keep all min(n, d) values.
